postings.title: RF Engineer (Level IV) - TS/SCI w/Poly clearance with Security Clearance
top_requirements: Design, analyze, integrate, and test ground‑modem RF hardware from schematic through prototype verification
Perform RF link budget calculations, noise‑figure and gain analysis, and EVM characterization for satellite communications modems
Develop and execute hardware bring‑up and sustainment test plans, including RF performance validation and troubleshooting
postings.summary: Design and test RF modem hardware for satellite ground stations, a role that leverages deep RF and communications experience. The hands‑on nature and focus on modem design align well with the candidate’s background.

postings.title: MTS Signal Integrity
top_requirements: Develop high‑speed DDR memory interface signal‑integrity models and simulate >16 GT/s links
Create and run SI/PI measurement plans using vector network analyzers and time‑domain reflectometry
Collaborate with package and layout teams to optimize trace geometry and mitigate crosstalk
postings.summary: Work on signal‑integrity for next‑generation memory interfaces, providing hands‑on high‑speed design experience that matches the candidate’s RF and signal‑processing skills. Although lower‑paid, it offers direct IC‑level work.

postings.title: Communications & Networks Systems Development Engineer-Associate with Security Clearance
top_requirements: Design and prototype advanced line‑of‑sight and beyond‑line‑of‑sight communications waveforms for defense platforms
Develop link‑budget and RF performance models, including propagation loss, antenna gain, and interference mitigation
Implement and validate real‑time signal‑processing algorithms on FPGA/ASIC testbeds
postings.summary: Lead development of cutting‑edge communications systems for military platforms, a perfect fit for the candidate’s satellite modem and RF expertise while moving toward broader defense applications.

postings.title: Communications Engineer, Senior - Secret
top_requirements: Develop and integrate communications payloads for airborne warning and control systems, including RF front‑end and baseband processing
Conduct RF performance testing, including IIP3, spurious emissions, and link‑budget verification
Provide technical support for system integration and flight‑test validation
postings.summary: Hands‑on communications engineering for AWACS platforms, matching the candidate’s RF and modem background while staying within the defense sector.

postings.title: AEHF Communications Engineer with Security Clearance
top_requirements: Lead design of secure satellite communications links for the Advanced Extremely High Frequency (AEHF) program
Perform RF link‑budget analysis, waveform design, and hardware validation on ground‑segment equipment
Coordinate with government and industry partners to integrate cryptographic modules and ensure compliance with classified requirements
postings.summary: Senior communications role on a high‑value classified satellite program, directly applying the candidate’s satellite modem and RF expertise in a senior technical capacity.
